_comment: The first-party catalogue: what MetaRush already does, as abilities in the menu and in find. Generated from each operation's ops.Offer annotation by METARUSH_UPDATE_CATALOGUE=1 go test ./internal/catalog -run TestFirstPartyCatalogue; never edit by hand. IDs are stable: one taken away moves to retired and is never used again.

abilities.name: metarush/ai-cut-outs
abilities.title: AI cut-outs
abilities.does: Takes a picture's background away with Apple Vision on this computer, as a new picture; nothing leaves it.

abilities.name: metarush/ai-larger-pictures
abilities.title: AI larger pictures
abilities.does: Makes a picture 2 or 4 times larger with an AI model on this computer; nothing leaves it.

abilities.name: metarush/ai-music
abilities.title: AI music
abilities.does: Makes music from a description; priced first.

needs.leaves: your words leave this computer

abilities.name: metarush/ai-narration
abilities.title: AI narration
abilities.does: Reads your script in a natural AI voice with ElevenLabs; lines that didn't change are reused for free. Priced first.

needs.leaves: the script's words leave this computer

abilities.name: metarush/ai-pictures
abilities.title: AI pictures
abilities.does: Makes a picture from a description, or changes one of yours, with an AI service; priced first.

needs.leaves: your words and any pictures you give it leave this computer

abilities.name: metarush/ai-sound-effects
abilities.title: AI sound effects
abilities.does: Makes a sound effect from a description; priced first.

needs.leaves: your words leave this computer

abilities.name: metarush/ai-speech
abilities.title: AI speech
abilities.does: Says any words in an AI voice as a new sound clip; priced first.

needs.leaves: the words leave this computer

abilities.name: metarush/art-in-git
abilities.title: Art kept in git
abilities.does: Keeps the pictures in a repository's folders as pictures of their own, each pinned to the commit.

abilities.name: metarush/automatic-call-cut
abilities.title: Automatic call cuts
abilities.does: Cuts a call automatically — whoever is talking, reactions, split layouts — and explains each choice.

abilities.name: metarush/balance-colour
abilities.title: Balance colour
abilities.does: Balances a clip's colour and brightness; the original is kept.

abilities.name: metarush/best-moments
abilities.title: Best moments
abilities.does: Finds the moments worth a look across a project or one clip, from what was said, pauses and picture changes.

abilities.name: metarush/brand-from-a-site
abilities.title: A website's brand
abilities.does: Suggests a brand kit from a web page you brought in: its logo, colours and font, each with why.

abilities.name: metarush/call-clean-up
abilities.title: Call clean-up
abilities.does: Finds what calls leave behind — call talk, dead air, frozen webcams, sound dropouts — for you to accept or skip.

abilities.name: metarush/call-recordings
abilities.title: Call recordings
abilities.does: Brings in a call app's recording folder, a recording per person, lined up by their sound.

abilities.name: metarush/call-switches
abilities.title: Picture switches in calls
abilities.does: Finds where a call recording's picture switches, to the frame, and who is on screen in each shot.

abilities.name: metarush/caption-check
abilities.title: Caption check
abilities.does: Lists the words in a version's captions worth a look before it goes out.

abilities.name: metarush/caption-looks
abilities.title: Caption looks
abilities.does: Gives the cut's captions one of six looks in your brand's colours and font.

abilities.name: metarush/captions-files
abilities.title: Captions files
abilities.does: A version's captions as a file for any player or platform, with every text fix made since.

abilities.name: metarush/change-a-spoken-word
abilities.title: Change a spoken word
abilities.does: Says a word or short phrase differently in the speaker's own voice copy, with their consent, checked on this computer and marked as changed everywhere; priced first.

needs.leaves: the new words, with the speaker's words around them, leave this computer for the service that holds the voice copy

abilities.name: metarush/changes-as-pull-request
abilities.title: Changes back as a pull request
abilities.does: Sends an approved Remotion version's changes back to its repository as a new branch and a pull request.

needs.leaves: the version's changes leave this computer, for its repository

abilities.name: metarush/clearer-voices
abilities.title: Clearer voices
abilities.does: Makes voices clearer on this computer, with less room and background noise; free.

abilities.name: metarush/cloud-folders
abilities.title: Files from Google Drive or Dropbox
abilities.does: Brings footage and pictures in from a Google Drive or Dropbox folder through your own rclone, without syncing the folder.

abilities.name: metarush/cloud-transcripts
abilities.title: Cloud transcripts
abilities.does: Writes down a clip's words with an AI service instead of on this computer, only when you ask; priced first.

needs.leaves: the clip's sound leaves this computer

abilities.name: metarush/cloud-voices
abilities.title: Voices cleaned in the cloud
abilities.does: Separates voices from everything else with ElevenLabs; priced first.

needs.leaves: the voices' sound leaves this computer

abilities.name: metarush/code-slides
abilities.title: Code slides
abilities.does: A slide of a repository file's lines, highlighted, that says exactly where they came from.

abilities.name: metarush/contact-sheets
abilities.title: Contact sheets
abilities.does: A labeled grid of frames from a clip: one per shot, then picture changes and new speakers.

abilities.name: metarush/cover-call-names
abilities.title: Cover printed names
abilities.does: Covers the names a call app printed in the picture with your own name bar for the whole video.

abilities.name: metarush/delivery
abilities.title: Delivery
abilities.does: Exports finished videos to a folder with a notes file each, checked, and never over an older file.

abilities.name: metarush/delivery-notes
abilities.title: Titles, chapters and show notes
abilities.does: Keeps a version's title, description, chapters and show notes for delivery.

abilities.name: metarush/diagrams
abilities.title: Diagrams
abilities.does: Draws a diagram described in Mermaid or D2 as a picture for the cut.

abilities.name: metarush/dubbing
abilities.title: Dubbing
abilities.does: Dubs a clip into another language in its speakers' voices, with their consent; priced first.

needs.leaves: the clip's sound leaves this computer

abilities.name: metarush/even-loudness
abilities.title: Even out loudness
abilities.does: Makes a recording as loud as the rest, all the way through; the original is kept.

abilities.name: metarush/faces
abilities.title: Faces across clips
abilities.does: Finds the faces in your footage and recognizes the people you named, across every clip.

abilities.name: metarush/find-and-replace
abilities.title: Find and replace in transcripts
abilities.does: Changes words wherever they are said; each keeps its timing, and it can be undone.

abilities.name: metarush/fitted-music
abilities.title: Music fitted to the cut
abilities.does: Puts music under the cut that ends on a phrase or a beat and gets quieter when someone talks.

abilities.name: metarush/footage-files
abilities.title: Footage from files
abilities.does: Adds video and sound files: each copied into MetaRush's storage once, then written down and looked at.

abilities.name: metarush/generated-shots
abilities.title: Generated shots
abilities.does: Makes a new video shot from a description; priced first and paid to the service directly.
words: make a clip from a prompt

needs.leaves: your words and any pictures you give it leave this computer

abilities.name: metarush/github-repositories
abilities.title: GitHub repositories
abilities.does: Brings in a GitHub repository at a commit — its text files, README and history — with your own git sign-in.

abilities.name: metarush/larger-pictures
abilities.title: Larger, sharper pictures
abilities.does: Makes a small picture larger and sharper for a full-screen shot.

abilities.name: metarush/lip-sync
abilities.title: Lip sync
abilities.does: Matches the lips in part of a clip to new sound, with the consent of everyone in it; priced first.

needs.leaves: the part of the footage and the new sound leave this computer

abilities.name: metarush/matched-webcams
abilities.title: Matched webcams
abilities.does: Matches the webcams' brightness, contrast and colour to one person's picture, measured before and after.

abilities.name: metarush/offline-voices
abilities.title: Offline voices
abilities.does: Says any words in a free voice that runs on this computer; nothing leaves it.

abilities.name: metarush/other-voice
abilities.title: Another voice
abilities.does: Changes the voice in a recording to another voice, keeping the words and their timing; priced first.

needs.leaves: the recording's sound leaves this computer

abilities.name: metarush/own-presenters
abilities.title: A person's own presenter
abilities.does: Makes a presenter of a person at an AI service from their approved look, a training take and their consent filmed on camera, naming the service; people only, priced first.

needs.leaves: a video of the person and their filmed consent leave this computer, and the service keeps the presenter until it is retired

abilities.name: metarush/pauses-and-cuts
abilities.title: Pauses, cuts and loud parts
abilities.does: Measures a clip: its pauses, cuts and picture changes, black or frozen picture, and how loud it is.

abilities.name: metarush/pictures-and-pdfs
abilities.title: Pictures, PDFs and fonts
abilities.does: Adds pictures, logos, PDF pages and fonts for your cuts; iPhone photos are converted on the way in.

abilities.name: metarush/post-to-youtube
abilities.title: Post to YouTube
abilities.does: Posts an approved version to your own channel as you, with its title, description, chapters and captions; a person does it every time.

needs.leaves: the version's video, title, description and captions leave this computer, for YouTube

abilities.name: metarush/presenter-clips
abilities.title: Presenter clips
abilities.does: A presenter reads a clip's sound or a narration line on camera: a person's own presenter, with their consent, or a stock presenter licensed for client work; priced first.

needs.leaves: the sound it reads leaves this computer

abilities.name: metarush/quality-check
abilities.title: Quality check
abilities.does: Watches and listens to a finished video before it goes out: words cut off, captions over faces, sound too quiet.

abilities.name: metarush/ready-to-deliver
abilities.title: Ready to deliver?
abilities.does: Says whether a version can go out to a client, or what holds it — the quality check, promises not kept, sign-offs still waiting — with a step to clear each.

abilities.name: metarush/reduce-grain
abilities.title: Reduce grain
abilities.does: Reduces the grain of a dark or noisy picture; the original is kept.

abilities.name: metarush/remotion-clips
abilities.title: Remotion compositions as clips
abilities.does: Makes a composition of an approved Remotion version into a clip, drawn with no network.

abilities.name: metarush/remotion-projects
abilities.title: Remotion projects
abilities.does: Brings in a Remotion project from a folder or a GitHub repository; a person approves each version.

abilities.name: metarush/remotion-refreshes
abilities.title: Remotion refreshes
abilities.does: Runs a Remotion project's own steps to bring its data up to date, in a sandbox, started by a person.

abilities.name: metarush/remove-background
abilities.title: A photo's subject
abilities.does: Takes the background out of a photo or a logo, leaving its subject; a background that isn't one plain colour needs a Mac.

abilities.name: metarush/remove-hum
abilities.title: Remove hum
abilities.does: Takes the electrical hum out of a recording's sound; the original is kept.

abilities.name: metarush/remove-ums
abilities.title: Remove ums
abilities.does: Suggests the ums, repeats and false starts to take out of the cut, each heard first.

abilities.name: metarush/repository-cards
abilities.title: Repository cards
abilities.does: A card about a repository: its languages, how active it is and its history.

abilities.name: metarush/scene-descriptions
abilities.title: Scene descriptions
abilities.does: Claude Code writes a sentence or two about each scene, so you can search for what is seen.

needs.leaves: pictures of each scene leave this computer, for Claude

abilities.name: metarush/share-for-review
abilities.title: Share a version for review
abilities.does: Sends someone outside the workspace an expiring link to a version's review copy and its words, and brings their comments back.

needs.leaves: the review copy, and its words if you include them, go to people outside the workspace through your cloud bucket

abilities.name: metarush/shorts
abilities.title: Shorts
abilities.does: Makes a short for phones from a stretch of any footage, framed and captioned in the house style.

abilities.name: metarush/spoken-language
abilities.title: Each clip's language
abilities.does: Says which language each clip is spoken in, and writes its words down in that language.

abilities.name: metarush/stand-in-narration
abilities.title: Stand-in narration
abilities.does: A free robotic voice to time narration before you record it or choose an AI voice.

abilities.name: metarush/steady-footage
abilities.title: Steady shaky footage
abilities.does: Steadies a shaky camera; the original is kept.

abilities.name: metarush/studio-voices
abilities.title: Studio voices
abilities.does: Makes voices sound as if recorded in a studio, on this computer: slower, and stronger than clearer voices.

abilities.name: metarush/tighten-pauses
abilities.title: Tighten pauses
abilities.does: Shortens long pauses between words anywhere in the cut, each one heard first.

abilities.name: metarush/timeline-import
abilities.title: Timelines from other editors
abilities.does: Makes a cut from a timeline another editing app exported (OpenTimelineIO, FCPXML, Final Cut Pro 7 XML, EDL), matched to your footage.

abilities.name: metarush/timelines
abilities.title: Timelines for other editors
abilities.does: Writes a version of a cut as a timeline another editing app opens, with its clips in place.

abilities.name: metarush/transcripts
abilities.title: Transcripts and captions
abilities.does: Writes down what is said in your footage on this computer, with its pauses and loud parts.

abilities.name: metarush/translated-captions
abilities.title: Captions in other languages
abilities.does: Keeps Claude Code's translation of a version's captions, line by line, marked as machine-translated.

needs.leaves: the captions' words leave this computer, for Claude

abilities.name: metarush/trim-flashes
abilities.title: Trim flashes
abilities.does: Trims split-second flashes of another picture at the edges of the cut's clips, at the exact switch.

abilities.name: metarush/trim-silent-ends
abilities.title: Trim silent ends
abilities.does: Trims the silence at the start and end of a recording; the original is kept.
words: cut the silence at the start

abilities.name: metarush/video-links
abilities.title: Videos from links
abilities.does: Imports a video from a link, downloaded on this computer, with where it came from.

abilities.name: metarush/voice-copies
abilities.title: Voice copies
abilities.does: Copies a person's voice, with their recorded consent, so AI speech can be in their voice; priced first.

needs.leaves: a recording of the person's voice leaves this computer

abilities.name: metarush/web-pages
abilities.title: Web pages
abilities.does: Takes a dated snapshot of a web page: pictures of it on a computer and a phone, its words, colours and logo.

abilities.name: metarush/whats-on-screen
abilities.title: What's on screen
abilities.does: Says what's on screen in a clip, line by line: the kind of shot, faces, the setting, things and words shown.

abilities.name: metarush/who-speaks
abilities.title: Who speaks
abilities.does: Tells the voices in your footage apart and recognizes the people you named, on this computer.
